Description.DefaultText: Hidden counter: ticks until a fairy ring's toadstools can be picked again.

//RingPicked: Feature 29 (plan section 29): the fairy ring's picking cooldown. 'Pick Toadstools' writes +RING_PICK_COOLDOWN = 192 ticks (two game days, a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER) and offers itself only at 0; the stat falls 1 a tick to its floor of 0. One counter for every ring, so picking in one grove holds the next for two days (rings are rare). Read only as a RequiredStatValues entry of the ring's own action, whose stat resolves because this file ships.
